item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Replace single-negative training margins with diagnostics that reveal failures against plausible competitors. Seek inexpensive, reproducible audits using training-history prefixes, popularity strata, and title/description similarity without pretrained weights. Compare sampled rankings with chunked full-catalog rankings on a fixed training-user cohort; report uncertainty and candidate-distribution sensitivity. Keep these auxiliary audits distinct from the unchanged host validation HR@10.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation sampled ranking bias full catalog hard negatives popularity stratification rank reliability 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Develop controlled probes that distinguish reliance on recent specific interests from broad item associations. Seek matched history interventions and backbone/residual ablations, measuring candidate-score changes and recommendation stability while preserving causal prefixes and padding semantics. Validate probe specificity with synthetic failure controls; distinguish model sensitivity from causal user preference and connect findings to concrete architectural or training changes.","query":"sequential recommender diagnostic probes history perturbation recency specificity shortcut learning component ablation negative controls 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Translate qualitative feedback into an evidence-grounded audit of the twenty users’ full-catalog recommendations. Seek methods that label supported matches, explicit textual conflicts, and insufficient evidence separately, using only histories, titles, and descriptions. Equipment ownership, compatibility, satisfied needs, and current intent must remain unknown unless supported. Examine annotation agreement, abstention coverage, and matched broad-versus-specific recommendation pairs before treating these signals as training objectives.","query":"recommendation explanation evaluation evidence grounding selective prediction abstention user feedback annotation compatibility intent uncertainty 2024 2025 2026"}]}
